summary: xAI released grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview, an image-to-video model available via the xAI API in preview that animates a still image into a short cinematic clip based on a text prompt.

practices.reason: The new preview model turns a still image into video with camera moves and physics, a multimodal capability an engineering team could evaluate for media pipelines.
practices.quote: grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview turns a single still image into fluid, cinematic video.
